verses.73:13: وَطَعَامࣰ ا ذَا غُصَّةࣲ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا

en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
meaning: The root غَصَّ (ghaṣṣa) denotes choking on food. Ibn Fāris notes the root carries nothing but this sense — الغصص بالطعام — a morsel lodged in the throat.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
